flows.title: Create a cold email campaign
steps: Under Engage, click Campaigns to open the Email Campaigns dashboard, click + Create Campaign, enter a campaign name, and click Continue.
On the Leads tab, click + Add Leads and choose a source — upload a CSV, import from a CRM, import from saved lists, or add from SmartProspect.

On Configure Upload Settings, choose how the leads are processed: the global block list, the unsubscribe list, the community bounce list, and whether leads already in this campaign are skipped or re-added.
On Map Your Fields, review the mapping Smartlead suggests for each column, adjust any that are wrong, then click Import Leads.
On the Sequence tab, click + Create First Step, choose a step type (Email, Manual Task, or Call), and fill in its details, such as the subject line and body for an email step.
On the Email Accounts tab, select the sending accounts to assign to the campaign.
On the Settings tab, configure the schedule, then click Launch Campaign.

flows.title: Find prospects with SmartProspect
steps: Under Engage, click Prospect Finder to open the SmartProspect screen.
Apply filters — such as industry, company name, domain, keywords, revenue, or location — to narrow the search to your ideal customer profile.
Review the prospect list, select the leads you want to enrich, and click Find emails.
Once your list is ready, select the verified contacts and click Push to Campaign.

flows.title: Review campaign performance
steps: Select Email Campaign from the left navigation to open the Campaign Dashboard, and toggle between the All Campaigns and Folders views.
Use the filter icon to narrow campaigns by status, tag, or client name, or use the search bar to find a campaign by name.
Use the column selector to choose which metrics appear, such as Opened, Clicked, Replied, Positive Reply, and Bounced.
Review the metrics for each campaign, and select the Go to Master Inbox link in the Positive Reply column to see the conversations.
